observations.assertion: Nonzero bounded-denominator 2-adic integral power series has a least coefficient valuation and a least index attaining it.
observations.inputs: Discrete coefficient valuations bounded below; finite preceding coefficients.

observations.assertion: For sufficiently small positive valuation of z, the least-index minimal coefficient term uniquely dominates, so the convergent series is nonzero.
observations.inputs: Nonarchimedean valuation; convergence and positive valuation of z.

observations.assertion: Primitive 2-power cyclotomic parameters have valuation 1/2^(n-1), tending to zero; finitely many orders and roots can be zeros.
observations.inputs: Eisenstein polynomial (1+t)^(2^(n-1))+1; trivial root handled separately.

observations.assertion: An element killed by nonzero series specializes to zero wherever the annihilator evaluates nonzero.
observations.inputs: Compatible module specialization to characteristic-zero field; scalar invertibility. No cohomology base-change isomorphism used.

observations.assertion: Infinitely many nonzero specializations in each sign contradict torsion and imply generic nonvanishing.
observations.inputs: Retained actual sign coefficient ring must have bounded-denominator series; reciprocal formula, nonzero smoothing, finite exceptional L-values and infinite characters of each sign are separate.
